description: Benchmark scenarios for scripts/benchmark.py. S0 is the baseline; each other scenario switches on one factor family relative to it. Re-equation scenarios recompute treatment and outcome on an existing text corpus through synthetic_data.reequation.reequation_cohort; S5 and S6 need text written with generation-time switches. See docs/benchmarks.md.

scenarios.label: Baseline
scenarios.factor: Confounders and effect modifiers only, as in the generator's default process

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 6 features; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: Instruments and prognostic-only variables
scenarios.factor: Two instruments (treatment equation only) and two prognostic-only variables (outcome equation only) added to the baseline roles

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 10 features; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: Dual-role variables and modifier main effects
scenarios.factor: Two variables that are both confounders and effect modifiers, and outcome main effects for every effect modifier

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 8 features; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: Nonlinear h(M)
scenarios.factor: Threshold nonlinearity of continuous features in the outcome main terms and the treatment interaction terms

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 6 features, some continuous; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: One unmeasured confounder, strength 0.5
scenarios.factor: One latent standard-normal confounder U that never appears in the text, entering both equations at half the scale of the measured confounders

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 6 features; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: One unmeasured confounder, strength 1.0
scenarios.factor: One latent standard-normal confounder U that never appears in the text, entering both equations at the scale of the measured confounders

source.requirements: dataset.parquet, metadata.json and generation_config.json; a true_<variable> column for every metadata feature; at least 6 features; no post-treatment notes

scenarios.label: MNAR documentation
scenarios.factor: Each characteristic is shown to the note writer with a probability that depends on its value (missing not at random); the baseline roles are re-equated on that corpus

source.requirements: a corpus generated with the generation settings below (LLM text); it is then re-equated with the baseline roles for every size and seed

generation.clinical_question: Compare vinorelbine to gemcitabine for advanced/metastatic NSCLC.

scenarios.label: Post-treatment leak
scenarios.factor: Notes dated after the index date describe a treatment-caused event; one run reads them through the text column and one run uses dated-notes input, which drops them

source.requirements: a corpus generated with the generation settings below (LLM text, with notes.parquet, index_date and clinical_text_with_post_treatment); re-equation refuses such corpora, so cells are seeded subsamples of it

generation.clinical_question: Compare vinorelbine to gemcitabine for advanced/metastatic NSCLC.

run_variants.name: text_column
run_variants.description: clinical_text_with_post_treatment as the text column, so post-index notes reach the analysis

run_variants.name: dated_notes
run_variants.description: dated-notes input from notes.parquet, which keeps only notes dated before index_date
